stacking.note: Front-plane VSF over the SFP+ ports, up to 4 members, including long-range 10G links between sites

power.summary: 12-port: external DIN rail PSUs (sold separately), two inputs, non-sharing. 24-port: fixed internal 300W PSU

licensing: No switch software license required; HPE Aruba Networking Central subscription (Class 1) for cloud management
verifyNote: QuickSpecs describes a Layer 2 switch with static routing but also lists "OSPF support" under Layer 3 services; modeled as Layer 2. The VSF section also mentions 48-port and modular models that do not exist in the 4100i line, and does not say which ports VSF uses or whether the 12-port model (2 SFP+ only) stacks. Operating temperature is -40 to 60C with no airflow, 70C at 0.2 m/s, -34 to 75C at 1 m/s, derated to 50C with non-industrial optics

poeBudgets.config: 1x JL819A 240W AC DIN PSU, up to 50C
1x JL821A 240W DC DIN PSU (48 to 55V input), up to 50C
1x JL820A 480W AC DIN PSU, up to 50C

redundancy.detail: Two DC power inputs for two external DIN rail PSUs; redundant but not load-sharing. PSUs sold separately

models.note: PoE derates with temperature (JL820A: 360W to 50C, 320W at 60C, 200W at 70C) and with low DC input on the JL821A (150W at 24V, 60W at 12V). With two PSUs, set the budget to the smaller one. Rack mounting needs the JL822A 3RU kit
